opening.argument: The presentation describes the Polkadot Blockchain Academy as an educational program built around coursework, not financial gain. It identifies a five-week in-person academic program with daily lectures and practical assignments, while the displayed curriculum shows both a fully online introductory course and an in-person cohort with common, dApps off-chain, and protocol on-chain tracks. The invitation to join a mailing list is framed as a way to hear more about the program. Registration, participation, community, and repository links likewise serve as course information and application updates. Nothing in the supplied material asks viewers to invest, promises financial returns, or demands credentials. These concrete teaching formats and technical modules support treating the presentation as an educational and operational overview.

citations.quote: It was a five-week in-person truly academic program consisting of daily lectures practical assignments
if you would like to hear more, do sign up to our mailing list
